1. **R0 — Restore self-documenting governance.** The ledger, generated state, PR template, change-impact gate, stale-state check, reviewable main-governance design, and bounded branch-retirement lifecycle are merged and green; provider ruleset and ordinary merged-branch auto-deletion remain separately evidenced owner settings. 3. **R2 — Synchronize Proof & State.** Proof & State points to exact DoneState commits and external review states. (1 complete)
4. **R3 — Separate Marketplace development from production.** A separate development OAuth App and draft listing can test lifecycle events without changing either production app. (1 active)
5. **R4 — Prepare unrestricted standalone customer access.** Standalone customers can inspect and delete their state, operators can support failures, and useful outcomes are measured before unrestricted self-serve GA. (4 active)
6. **R5 — Close independent-verification proof gaps.** OpsTruth restores an authenticated exact-head read lane, both products enforce one versioned verification response contract, and synthetic plus live cross-product loops have exact evidence. (3 complete, 2 deferred, 1 planned)
7. **R6 — Release and grow only through explicit gates.** Owned-domain release, OpenAI distribution, GitHub Marketplace distribution and later capabilities advance through independent explicit gates; no external directory becomes the sole route to market and fleet authority remains last. (2 active, 10 deferred, 3 planned, 1 blocked)

### E-057 — Stage-only npm OIDC release lane candidate

- **Date:** 2026-10-03
- **Situation:** DoneState 0.1.3 is release-ready on protected main, but the repository had no npm publication workflow and this environment has no npm publishing connector or registry publication receipt. - **Verification:** Current npm documentation supports GitHub Actions trusted publishing with short-lived OIDC credentials and requires id-token: write on a GitHub-hosted runner. npm also supports staged publishing, where npm stage publish places an existing package version in a review area and final public release requires a maintainer's explicit 2FA approval. The candidate adds a manual-dispatch, main-only workflow that pins npm 11.19.0, validates the exact package/version, reads the registry to reject an already-published version, runs npm ci plus the repository's complete npm run check gate, and performs npm stage publish only. It adds no NODE_AUTH_TOKEN or direct npm publish step. docs/CLI-RELEASE.md records the one-time trust command and fail-closed release procedure.

Repository code can prepare the lane but cannot truthfully claim that external npm trust relationship exists until npm records it.; stale=2026-10-10
